test_cases.name: create_patient
evaluation_criteria: Test the main positive scenario for POST /patients to create a patient
Use PatientService.createPatient with PatientModel type
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth using optional chaining
Generate random values for name fields to avoid collisions
Include emergencyContact nested object with name, phone, relationship

test_cases.name: get_patient_by_id
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /patients/{patientId} to retrieve a patient
Include setup hook to create a patient first
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains complete patient record including allergies array
Assert emergencyContact nested object is present

test_cases.name: create_appointment_nested_resource
evaluation_criteria: Test POST /patients/{patientId}/appointments nested resource
Use AppointmentService.createAppointment with patientId parameter
Assert status code is 201
Assert response contains dateTime, duration, and type fields
Duration value should respect min/max constraints (15-120)

test_cases.name: list_appointments_date_range
evaluation_criteria: Test GET /patients/{patientId}/appointments with date range parameters
Use from and to query parameters for date filtering
Assert status code is 200
Assert response contains appointments array

test_cases.name: create_patient_with_allergies
evaluation_criteria: Test creating a patient with allergies array populated
Include at least one allergy string in the allergies array
Assert response allergies field is an array
Assert gender uses one of the defined enum values (male, female, other, prefer_not_to_say)

test_cases.name: create_appointment_datetime_handling
evaluation_criteria: Test that dateTime field is properly handled as ISO 8601 datetime
Assert response dateTime is a valid datetime string
Use proper date/time values in the request
Assert status field is present in response
